mapper.sql: e.exercise_id AS exerciseId,e.exercise_id AS id,e.title,e.title AS label,e.instruction,e.input_type AS inputType, e.category_id AS categoryId,c.name AS categoryName,c.color,e.difficulty,e.content_type AS contentType, e.pronunciation_rule AS pronunciationRule,e.target_phonemes AS targetPhonemes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exercise_items i WHERE i.exercise_id=e.exercise_id) AS itemCount
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exercises e JOIN practice_categories c ON c.category_id=e.category_id
SELECT FROM exercises e JOIN practice_categories c ON c.category_id=e.category_id WHERE e.exercise_id=#{exerciseId} AND e.active=TRUE
